extract_subsequences: extract overlapping subsequences from a batch of trajectories given start indices and subsequence length
sample_start_indices: sample random starting indices from a valid range for each trajectory in a batch
test_extract_subsequences: test extract_subsequences with trajectory arrays and start indices to verify correct subsequence extraction
test_sample_start_indices: test sample_start_indices with rng key and batch size to verify random index sampling
summarize_extract_subsequences: summarize extract_subsequences which extracts potentially overlapping subsequences from batched trajectory data
